tasks.title: Multiprompt Android runs phone checks for unrelated changes
tasks.description:
Problem

  • Multiprompt Android starts unnecessary phone checks.

  • Those checks can delay app updates.

  • Postbox's separate fix already shipped.

Fix

  • Run phone checks when relevant files change.

  • Keep every required phone check covered.

  • Keep stopping runs replaced by newer changes.

Done when

  • Unrelated changes avoid unnecessary phone checks.

  • Relevant changes still run their phone checks.

  • Before and after times come from real runs.

  • Android slowdown alarms stay quiet all day.

Risk: Missing a needed phone check. Undo: restore previous check rules.

Decision: none.

Remaining Android work from https://app.hypertask.ai/detail/project-11514/143.

Repository: https://github.com/valentinyeo/multiprompt-android.

Postbox's shipped change: https://github.com/valentinyeo/postbox/pull/449.
